replayNotes: The three chains ran at the same time, each section in its own pasta namespace, in run.sh order. The afr2 sections (frLater, frFinish, frSkip) were not run: they send no email, read no Mailpit message, save no logo and check none of the setup, allowed-domain or provider messages. frLater reads only the deployment-email notice, which wizardEnv also checks on bwiz.
bao ran the aoauth sections with POLICY_STAMP=br9976 so that policy, sso, twoFactor and ssoRemove share accounts, as the original run did with p11119.

bao sso attempt 1 (10:12 UTC): step 10 got 429 'Too many sign-in link requests' from POST /api/v1/auth/magic-link, and step 11 failed as a result. twoFactor attempt 1 step 3 got the same 429. Cause: the shared auth request budget (apps/api/src/auth/limits.ts, 30 sign-in link requests per client address in 15 minutes; not controlled by AUTH_RATE_LIMIT). All browser requests reach the app from one gateway address, and the window that opened at 10:01:41 during the lab seed was spent by the seed, org and policy running back to back. The auth code is the same at 4ca41822 and ad345da5. This is a timing cause, not an app change.

Before attempt 2 the bao chain driver was stopped after twoFactor attempt 1. Through the app API as Daniel, the two providers from attempt 1 (doc032-helix, doc032-harbor) were deleted and Business Portal SSO was set off again, the state that policy leaves. Allowed domains were unchanged. The Harbor staff address and its OIDC subject got an -r2 suffix, because attempt 1 had already invited that address and linked the subject. sso, twoFactor, crossPage, instancePinned, instanceSaved, phase base and ssoRemove then ran in run.sh order after 10:23:40 UTC, when the budget windows had ended. All passed.
In sso attempt 2, step 2 signed in an SSO staff account that attempt 1 had already made Active, so the change from Invited to Active was seen only in attempt 1 (which passed that step).
